items.title: [TASK] Qualify complete production capability profile and publish final release
items.body:
DUBFLOW_TASK_V1
Hard-Dependencies: #166,#167,#168,#169,#170,#171,#172,#173,#174
Soft-Dependencies: #19,#20,#21,#22,#61,#62,#65
Conflict-Domains: production-release-qualification,soak-chaos,release-workflow
Expected-Paths: tests/production/**,tests/soak/**,tests/chaos/**,scripts/release/**,.github/workflows/release.yml,.github/workflows/soak-release.yml,docs/production/**,docs/PROJECT_STATE.yaml
Required-CI: PR Fast + Integration + Windows Release + Release / Soak

## Outcome
Run final end-to-end qualification after all production capability leaves are integrated and publish one truthful stable release with complete supported capability evidence.

## Acceptance
- Windows clean-machine install/upgrade/rollback and auto-launch without system Python/FFmpeg/CUDA setup;
- real local media coverage for B1/B2, multi-speaker, OCR/orientation/cleanup, source acquisition, editable pack and optional CapCut handoff;
- 2-6 hour VFR/long-form and 100/500-item batch evidence with bounded memory, failure isolation, hashes and QC;
- hard-kill/reboot/sleep-resume, worker death, disk pressure/removable/NAS loss, model/runtime update failure, source outage and GPU OOM/CPU fallback evidence;
- every advanced capability has benchmark/resource/license/provenance/fallback evidence and the release profile declares exact supported scope;
- package, checksum, signature, manifest, installed smoke and report assets are consistent with exact main SHA;
- candidate and stable channels remain separate; no release claim is made for an unverified capability.

## Recovery
A failed qualification blocks publication only, produces an actionable report, and leaves the previous stable release and local-file fallback available.

## Lead recovery checkpoint — 2026-10-02

The project owner authorized lead coordination, implementation and one recurring coding task on 2026-10-02. This checkpoint orders recovery; it does not waive any acceptance, review, provenance, license, signing or CI gate and does not grant ownership of every live branch.

### Current integration baseline

Observed main: `9271c2552331d43686940b939e8b1ad70bdc9863`. The published v0.1.0 points to the earlier B1 commit `8a5ffcab15d4bed56f293596c903a0366b6a21ed`; main has newer B2/source code. Do not equate a merged implementation, passing fixture tests, or a release title with complete product qualification. #166 and #167 remain open until their acceptance/evidence is reconciled explicitly.

### Ordered recovery work

1. Repair trustworthy verification first: #186 / Draft #187 fixes selective Integration filename/rename handling and CI-control invalidation. Code commit `4721527a28245c77e50185494efe013bb8face27` has 21 focused local selector tests passing. Full hosted Integration and review are separate gates. Inherited failures exposed by full selection must be repaired or reported precisely, never suppressed.
2. Restore a truthful useful localization path before advanced claims. Production `_translate_with_argos` and `production-cpu-v1.json` currently provide English-to-Vietnamese only; `auto` does not prove correct Chinese routing. Scope a focused Chinese-source language/model/provenance task with pinned, license-reviewed models, unsupported-language failure, real translation evidence and B1 preservation. Verify desktop accessibility of B1/B2 controls rather than assuming worker integration implies UI availability.
3. Reconcile existing source acquisition #167 evidence, then complete #168 / #184 from source intake through actual materialization into the production local-file path. Preserve offline local-file mode, credential redaction, resume, dedup and poisoned-item isolation.
4. Resume existing production branches one at a time after reading live comments, ownership, current HEAD/base and required CI. Prefer finishing usable editable output #172 / #183 and review/regeneration #174 / #185, and resolve integration/recovery defects in #173 / #177. Preserve existing work; do not duplicate these tasks or infer ownership solely from an old heartbeat.
5. Promote #169 / #178 OCR/cleanup and #170 / #180 multi-speaker capabilities only with real model/media benchmarks, conservative fallbacks and worker/desktop integration. Coordinate with active #171 / #182 for audio/hardware rather than competing on worker/model namespaces.
6. Run this issue's complete qualification only after hard dependencies are actually satisfied. Keep previous usable output/release available and record exact supported scope; do not publish unverified advanced capabilities.

### Active-work preservation and merge ordering

PR #182 advanced during the lead inspection to `b423c1965f04b1b4d7ecccf2ad6a0f559860d92a` on current main. Its body still contains historical tested-base and local/remote reconciliation warnings. Treat it as active: read newer commits/checkpoints before any write; do not overwrite remote repairs or unknown local worker changes. No takeover was performed in this lead session.

Other observed Draft PRs: #184 (intake), #178 (visual), #180 (speaker), #183 (editable), #177 (operations), #185 (review). These snapshots are discovery pointers, not permanent locks or proof of staleness. #177/#178 reported non-mergeable during inspection. Each successor must re-read live state, recover/supersede leases with traceable lineage where appropriate, coordinate narrow shared paths, incorporate current main, and rerun the Issue's declared lanes. File-level mergeability is never enough.

### Scheduled-session contract

Use one DubFlow lead/coding task, not independent competing schedules. Each invocation reconstructs live GitHub state, resumes its valid Draft claim, produces a bounded code/test/CI-repair result or an exact external blocker, and persists evidence on the relevant Issue/PR. Do not create heartbeat-only commits or repeatedly rewrite this checkpoint without new progress. A prior active lease or legitimately running exact-head CI must not be displaced by the next invocation.

The initial container has Python/Git but no network clone or Cargo; focused code was reconstructed from verified GitHub blobs. A future runtime must check its own capabilities and mark unavailable Windows/GPU/full-checkout evidence NOT_RUN rather than inheriting a false success. Lead merges require all acceptance, exact-current-head/current-base checks and required review; no self-invented independent reviewer or bypass. Stable release publication remains gated by this issue's full evidence and signing requirements.

Update stale README/PROJECT_STATE descriptions alongside the relevant verified product delivery, not as a substitute for implementation. Live Issues, PR diffs and actual evidence take precedence over this dated checkpoint.

## Acceleration directive — 2026-10-02

The owner explicitly requested a faster cadence and more substantive work per invocation to reach production as quickly as possible. This directive supersedes the earlier three-hour / one-small-result session pacing, but preserves every acceptance, dependency, ownership, security, review and release requirement above.

### Activated cadence

The existing task was updated, not duplicated: **DubFlow Production Sprint**, enabled, `DTSTART;TZID=Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh:20261002T104000`, `RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY;INTERVAL=1`, flexible scheduling. The previous start was 12:00 with a three-hour interval. Hourly is the highest supported task frequency; do not create staggered duplicate schedules to bypass it. A schedule activation is not proof that a run occurred, that it ran for an hour, or that productivity increased by a particular multiplier.

### Workload and useful concurrency

- Select a working package of **3–5 small independently acceptable outcomes plus one non-conflicting fallback**. This is a planning target, not an invented completion quota. A substantial critical-path integration repair may occupy the package; report that honestly. Code, tests, docs and commits for one feature count as one outcome.
- Do not stop after the first commit, passing test, push or status update while execution capacity and eligible work remain. Work through the package using focused tests and recoverable checkpoints, and reserve capacity for final checks and actionable repairs.
- Keep **one active GitHub writer for this task**, **one item being edited**, and **up to two task-owned items/PRs waiting for CI or review**. The limit does not authorize closing inherited PRs. Keep separate leaf contracts/branches, validate leases at every transition, and serialize shared namespaces.
- While an exact-head CI run is legitimately queued/running, move to an eligible path-disjoint code/test/review unit instead of repeatedly polling or ending the session just to wait. Do not invalidate the running evidence with unrelated pushes. At the waiting-work limit, finish review/verification rather than accumulate more PRs.
- Read foundational context once per session and then use relevant diffs; always reread live HEAD/ownership before writes. Do not repeat a repository-wide audit or rewrite plans every invocation.
- Use actual permitted subagents for bounded preparation/test/review only if the runtime supplies them and handoffs can be read; do not pretend parallel workers or independent reviewers exist. All GitHub mutations remain coordinated.
- Fix actionable CI failures in the same invocation when feasible. Do not merely file another issue when a safe scoped repair can be implemented. An external blocker must include exact evidence and next action; a blocked namespace does not freeze independent eligible product work.

### Immediate package and delivery order

Live recheck during this adjustment: #187 remains Draft at `4721527a28245c77e50185494efe013bb8face27`; PR Fast run `36956100666` remains successful and Integration run `36956100700` remains failed. #188 is still open.

The next primary package is the workspace repair in #188: reconcile ownership, inventory the exact nested crates/registry commands, implement intentional membership with preserved dependency versions and Cargo-generated lockfile evidence where required, add regression protection, and run real Cargo/full deterministic Integration. These steps together are **one** coherent repair, not five completed tasks. Resolve subsequent actionable inherited failures without weakening coverage; rerun #187 on the resulting current HEAD/base and merge only when its acceptance/checks/review are satisfied. This directive does not claim #188 or grant another branch's lease.

While that verification is in flight, advance eligible non-conflicting work for the real Chinese-to-Vietnamese desktop B1/B2 path, source intake, and existing near-complete production PRs. Stop expanding CI/governance once the necessary verifier is sound. Prepare qualification harnesses and media cases as components become available instead of deferring all test preparation to the end. Preserve the full scope of #175: intermediate user-visible milestones are delivery ordering, not permission to remove advanced capability acceptance or call a partial build full production.

### Session evidence

Report actual outcomes as implemented / verified / merged / waiting / blocked, with commit HEAD/base, executed commands, CI run IDs, remaining acceptance and the next READY unit. When fewer than the planned outcomes finish, name the real bottleneck rather than inventing tasks or percentages. No new code or successful build is claimed by this schedule-and-workload adjustment itself.

items.title: Site coordination: work board, attribution in git (no in-file tags), stable CI order

labels.name: project:director-orchestrator
labels.description: Director-Orchestrator scope in this shared repository

items.body:
**[[Claude Code | Claude Opus 5.5 | 2026-09-26 | 22:04 UTC | BEGIN]]**

## Site coordination: sessions working in the same repo without tripping each other

The owner, 2026-09-26, verbatim:
> "I would love for yall to get to a level to work together without tripping one another up. Construction works work in the same spaces and operate just fine. I want the same here!"
> On visibility: "I want a creative or established solution for this."
> On tags: "Make the tag line process more helpful, or remove it completely from EVERYTHING and EVERYWHERE."
> On shared resources: "Come up with a process that can make this possible and stable! I want something that could work consistently, no matter the cost. Download whatever is needed!"
> On the plan (work board, Codex packet, ChatGPT as foreman): "Absolutely"

### 1. Visibility: the work board (who is working where)
- **The claim is a draft PR.** A session opens a draft PR as soon as it creates a branch, before its first real commit, and names itself in the description (`Session: <name>`). An open PR *is* the claim. This is the established "open a WIP PR early" practice.
- **The board is generated, never hand-maintained.** `scripts/site-board.py` builds it from GitHub: every open PR with its session, branch, head, changed files, CI state and queue position, plus which files more than one open PR touches (the overlaps). It can post the board as a pinned issue comment.
- **Overlap check before editing.** `scripts/site-board.py --check <files>` names every open PR that touches those files. Sessions run it before editing, and a Claude Code PreToolUse hook runs it on Edit/Write in this repo and warns. If a file is claimed, message its owner session first (cross-session message or the Director thread).

### 2. Attribution: out of file contents, into git
- **No more in-file tags.** No contribution tag lines are written into any file, in any provider's or tool's output.
- **Attribution lives in git and the PR.**
  - Commits carry trailers: `Contributed-by: <Assistant> | <Model>` and the existing `Co-Authored-By`.
  - The PR description carries one header line: `Sole author: <X>; assistance: <Y>`. The 52% sole-author rule is PR #284.
- **Enforcement.** The CI job keeps its name, **Contribution attribution**, but now checks trailers and the PR header, not file contents. `check_contribution_tags.py` is updated to match.
- **Removing the existing tags.** One mechanical PR strips every existing tag line from the repo. The foreman schedules it for a quiet moment. `scripts/strip-tag-lines.py` lets any in-flight branch drop its tags too, so leftover tag-only conflicts resolve automatically.
- **Other places the rule lives.** The docs (AGENTS.md, the attribution policy, the charter, templates), the provider skills and the Cursor rules all change the same way.

### 3. Shared resources: a stable order
- **CI runs once per head.** `push` runs only on `main`; PR branches run only on `pull_request`. That halves the load. A PR head that has been superseded cancels its own older runs, which it already does.
- **Capacity.** Add self-hosted runners with the same labels. This PC has 32 cores and 64 GB, so we go from 1 Windows + 1 WSL to 2 + 2.
- **A local test-lane cap.** `windows-postgres-test-lane.ps1` takes a machine-wide lock allowing at most 2 concurrent lanes. That stops local suites starving CI and causing timing flakes.
- **Foreman: the ChatGPT/Codex Director.** It reads the board, decides which session does what (no duplicate tasks), sequences pushes to CI (urgent unblockers first), and is the only one to "Update branch", merge main into someone else's branch, or cancel another session's runs.

### Work items (maintenance goes to Codex, per the owner's rule; the Director verifies and pushes)
- [ ] CI triggers: push only on main, keep the six check names (Codex).
- [ ] `scripts/site-board.py` with the `--check` overlap detector (Codex), plus the hook (Director).
- [ ] Attribution moved to trailers and the PR header: policy, checker, CI job, docs and tests (Codex).
- [ ] The mass tag-strip PR and `strip-tag-lines.py` (Codex), scheduled by the foreman.
- [ ] Local lane lock in `windows-postgres-test-lane.ps1` (Codex).
- [ ] Two more self-hosted runners (Director, ops).
- [ ] Foreman role accepted by ChatGPT (Director thread).

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

**[[Claude Code | Claude Opus 5.5 | 2026-09-26 | 22:04 UTC | END]]**

items.title: GL-SD-301P: non-routing RX-on-when-idle End Device firmware
items.body:
## Objective

Develop custom firmware for the GLEDOPTO **GL-SD-301P** so the installed Circle dimmer remains a mains-powered, always-listening Zigbee device but **does not route, accept children, or become a transit hop**.

Target live unit:

```text
friendly_name     LivingRoomCircleLightDimmer
IEEE              0xa4c13850cfcdb3a4
model             GL-SD-301P
manufacturer      GLEDOPTO
softwareBuildID   20651203
dateCode          20240704
current Zigbee    Router
```

Desired Zigbee architecture:

```c
ZB_ED_ROLE = 1
ZB_ROUTER_ROLE = 0
ZB_MAC_RX_ON_WHEN_IDLE = 1
PM_ENABLE = 0
powerSource = MAINS
```

When powered, the dimmer must be a reachable **leaf** only. When BSEED RIGHT removes mains, only this leaf disappears; no router/parent/transit path disappears.

BSEED RIGHT remains the deterministic physical hard-OFF mechanism. Do not change that architecture in this issue.

## Known facts

- The stock device advertises Router role; this is firmware behavior, not merely a Zigbee2MQTT label.
- Known GL-SD-301P captures use endpoint 11 with standard Basic / Groups / Scenes / OnOff / Level / Color / Touchlink clusters and OTA client cluster 0x0019.
- Telink's official Zigbee SDK explicitly supports a mains-powered End Device with RX-on-when-idle.
- romasku/tuya-zigbee-switch proves Router↔EndDevice role conversion is practical on supported Telink hardware, but its current firmware does **not** implement real phase-cut dimming.
- We do **not** yet know the exact Telink MCU/module or whether the power stage is driven directly by the Telink MCU or by a second MCU over UART.
- GLEDOPTO OTA identifiers are known to be ambiguous across hardware/firmware families. Never identify compatibility from manufacturerCode/imageType alone.

## Development target

Preserve/reproduce:

- On/Off server
- Level Control / dimming
- physical PUSH control
- minimum brightness behavior
- power-on behavior
- reporting
- direct-device binding compatibility
- reliable electrical OFF
- OTA client if safely possible
- endpoint 11 unless evidence justifies changing it

Development builds must use an unambiguous identity such as `GL-SD-301P-ED`.

## Phase 1 rule: SOFTWARE-ONLY / READ-ONLY EVIDENCE

Before anyone opens the installed module or flashes anything, exhaust every practical software-only probe.

No:
- OTA update/downgrade/schedule
- custom image serving
- factory reset/re-pair
- binding mutation
- coordinator-wide changes
- security reset
- experimental writes to manufacturer-specific attributes
- opening the installed production unit

A separate supervisor comment gives the exact software-only acquisition procedure.

## Required decision after Phase 1

```text
MCU_EXACT =
POWER_STAGE_CONTROL = SECOND_MCU_UART / TELINK_DIRECT / UNKNOWN
OTA_IDENTITY =
FIRST_CUSTOM_OTA_FEASIBLE = yes/no/unproven
PUBLIC_STOCK_BINARY =
SOFTWARE_ONLY_BLOCKERS =
SPARE_REQUIRED = yes/no
```

If software evidence cannot prove the remaining hardware facts, stop cleanly and specify exactly what a sacrificial spare must provide. The production installed unit is not the first canary.

Migrated from analienx/bseed#9; this repository is the authoritative ledger for GL-SD-301P firmware work.

items.body:
# sing-box — общий аудит и реестр внешних доказательств (не план)

> **Роль:** архив **физической приёмки нескольких функциональных направлений** и ссылок на CI/native/E2E, а не средство выдачи команд и не самостоятельный backlog. **Единственное актуальное техническое ТЗ на контроль, диагностику и воспроизводимость 10/10 — [#538](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/538).** Изменения в этом issue не имеют права мутировать ресурсы. Канон — только protected Git `main` + exact ReleaseSet; operator commands — #1. Все прежние «единственный cursor» и «CURRENT Stage» от 23 октября и ранее в истории этого issue являются историческими отчётами, не действующим приоритетом.

## Текущая карта задач и ответственности

| Issue | Только для чего |
|---|---|
| [#538](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/538) | **Единый P0-план реализации** Root Agent 10/10, 2 кодовых среза, end-to-end верификация, критерии закрытия |
| [#517](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/517) | **Только текущий физический статус VM5** и следующий реальный отказ, без дублирующего ТЗ |
| [#480](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/480) | **Только физическая матрица Root Agent capability/negative test** и ссылки на signed evidence |
| [#484](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/484) | **Закрытый принятый архитектурный контракт** full root полномочий и одного transport/owner |
| [#1](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/1) | **Единственный действующий operator inbox** `/host`; комментарии с командами и нативными ответами |
| [#2](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/2) / [#3](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/3) / [#4](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/4) | **Только функциональные границы** Line1 Windows TUN / Line2 proxy / Line3 Cloudflare Mesh Android; не второй план |
| [#60](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/60) / [#154](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/154) | **Только Windows-направление**, без несанкционированного TUN cutover |
| [#169](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/169) | **Только Cloudflare account/credential ownership и его исторические доказательства** |

## Последний VM5 **физический** доказательный срез (27.10.2026)

> Код движется независимо: PR #537 MERGED в `main=1f27d4661e8bc3b0d7a1f772be769a584bf3ff35`, [CI #40422549736](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40422549736) PASS. Это диагностическое изменение, **не** доказательство установки новой VM5 или снятия `pending=1`. Таблица ниже — более ранний физический срез.

- PR #535/#536 MERGED, main `159b7d3ef06f954399c63da1b430a198170547e9`; exact ReleaseSet `a195bccc…2a8090` PUBLISHED. Источник: [CI #40419271530](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40419271530), [post-merge #40420569866](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40420569866).
- [Root code-only recover #40420768407](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40420768407): новый бинарник/trust установлен; no resource replay.
- [Fresh APPLY #40420973136](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40420973136): WARP уже STOPPED — повтор STOP не делался; gateway STOP readback OK, 3 контейнера заменены. **Но** poststate `HOST_NATIVE_RUNTIME_POSTSTATE_MISMATCH`, `runtime_ready=false`.
- [Подписанный Root snapshot #6429941976](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/1#issuecomment-6429941976): bundle matched, исходное `pending_count=1`, операция `issue1-comment-6429906995`, replay_allowed=false. Детали контейнеров из runner-copied диагностики не являются подтверждённым терминальным успешным APPLY.
- [Последний подписанный RECOVER #6429996161](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/issues/1#issuecomment-6429996161): runtime всё ещё `UNPROVEN_RUNTIME_READINESS`; pending=1, terminal VERIFIED отсутствует. Отмена отдельного hosted диагностического workflow [#40421881819](https://github.com/iamaman11/sing-box/actions/runs/40421881819) — **delivery failure**, не доказанная ошибка Root Agent.
- Line1 **4/4**, Line2 **6/6** good/bad auth, публичный TLS, WARP/DIRECT, external DNS/egress и reboot — **NOT ACCEPTED / NO-GO**. VM5 не считать готовой только по контейнерам RUNNING, digest MATCHED или зелёному CI.

## Правила доказательств и актуализации

1. На каждое утверждение PASS — exact Git+ReleaseSet/operation ID, действующий Root Ed25519 terminal receipt (или честное `UNPROVEN`), независимая проверка, физический poststate и внешний vantage для пользовательского datapath.
2. GitHub runner cancellation, CI, runner-copied protobuf и native observation без VERIFIED не превращать в физическую приёмку. Unknown BEGIN — no replay, никакой ручной purge.
3. **Текущие next actions описываются только в #538; VM5 живое состояние — только в #517.** Здесь добавлять только доказанные milestones после завершения действий; старые state/plan/phase в edit history не оживлять.
4. Не закрывать этот общий аудит как «полную приёмку» до закрытия связанных физических матриц/линий с независимыми terminal receipts.

items.title: [TASK] Integrate production Review Center and targeted regeneration
items.body:
DUBFLOW_TASK_V1
Hard-Dependencies: #163,#17,#22,#71
Soft-Dependencies: #6,#20
Conflict-Domains: desktop-review,targeted-regeneration
Expected-Paths: apps/desktop/src/features/review/**,contracts/review/**,engine/dubflow/qc/**,crates/job-supervisor/invalidation/**,crates/job-supervisor/app/**,tests/review/**,tests/integration/production_local_file/**,engine/dubflow/worker/production_job.py,tests/production/worker/test_translation_overrides.py
Required-CI: PR Fast + Integration + Windows Release

## Outcome
Make confidence findings, review and targeted regeneration part of the production workflow. Quick Mode must finish automatically while a user can correct one risky cue/voice/cleanup decision and rerun only affected descendants.

## Acceptance
- desktop displays grouped ASR/OCR conflicts, speaker/voice uncertainty, translation anomalies, TTS/mix failures, inpaint risk, sync/QC warnings with exact time ranges and output paths;
- user can preview source/translated text/assigned voice and edit one cue or mapping; edits are versioned and provenance-preserving;
- invalidation graph identifies exactly which downstream stages rerun before confirmation; unrelated long-form artifacts remain valid;
- replacement artifacts are validated atomically before old valid artifacts are retired; undo/revert restores the prior valid graph without full-job rebuild;
- review is available for B1/B2 and degrades to generic warnings when advanced engines are absent;
- four-hour synthetic and representative real-media tests prove one-cue regeneration does not rerun unrelated ASR/OCR;
- liveness/QC failures remain visible and actionable rather than forcing full manual review.

## Recovery
Review Center is optional for standard export. If it is unavailable, the canonical output and machine-readable QC remain valid.


## Bounded follow-up after merged PR #218 — 2026-10-24

This is one narrow successor leaf, not full #174 acceptance. It verifies and, if needed, repairs the worker-level reviewed-translation rerun boundary introduced by #218.

- Sole writer: existing Coder 1 identity `codex/01a11204/issue-174-continuation`.
- Claim branch: `agent/issue-174-review-regeneration-regression`, created from the then-current main; immediately open one Draft PR with `DUBFLOW_PR_V1`, Issue #174, Lease-Owner, fresh Lease-Heartbeat, Tested-Base-SHA, Conflict-Domains and Expected-Paths. Re-read all open PRs/claims after opening.
- Allowed paths for this leaf only: `engine/dubflow/worker/production_job.py`, `tests/production/worker/test_translation_overrides.py`, and `tests/integration/production_local_file/test_review_regeneration.py`.
- Forbidden: desktop/native UI and IPC, supervisor wiring outside the existing issue scope, contracts, migrations, lockfiles, CI/workflows, source intake, model pins/downloads, release/publish, and all unrelated files.
- Acceptance: exercise `run_local_file` with deterministic fixtures/temp directories; prove a single reviewed cue override preserves cue IDs and integer timing, changes the override identity/output, and does not rerun ASR or translation; unchanged identity reuses validated output; injected QC failure preserves every previously published artifact and manifest byte-for-byte; retry publishes the corrected output atomically with no partial artifact promoted. If implementation needs a path outside this leaf, stop and report the exact gap rather than expanding scope.
- Tests: `python -m unittest discover -s tests/production/worker -p 'test_translation_overrides.py' -v`; `python -m unittest discover -s tests/integration/production_local_file -p 'test_review_regeneration.py' -v`; PR Fast + Integration + Windows Release on the final HEAD and current base. SKIPPED is not PASS. No Windows GUI/media acceptance or full #174 acceptance is implied by hermetic tests.
